claim: The frozen GOLEM symbolic pilot is aesthetically non-inferior to a strong Blender procedural-agent baseline while making warm-start revisions substantially cheaper and rarely requiring direct mesh surgery.

sealedObstructions.observed: four PNG pixels and five GIF pixels differ
semantic colored-face match with different face serialization

family.description: Bilateral, faceless, plated, five-digit knuckle-walking stone guardians derived from the frozen golem-with-hands family master.

measurementContract.commonSurface: Anonymous exported mesh after reversible presentation transform only.
measurementContract.sidecar: Each arm emits the same named scopes and centerline/junction/contact landmarks; an independent verifier checks every landmark against the visible mesh before unblinding.
measurementContract.surfaceSampling: Verifier-owned canonical-triangle area sampling; arms do not choose or submit sample locations.
measurementContract.surfaceSamplingAlgorithm: Canonicalize each triangle by lexicographically sorting its three float64 vertex triples; sort triangles lexicographically; NumPy 2.5.1 Generator(PCG64) seed 7319 plus 100 times manifest scope ordinal plus declared instance ordinal; inverse-CDF triangle-area selection; sqrt-barycentric point sampling

regressionSemantics.noncritical: A revision with one or more failed /family/creatures/*/revisions/*/preserve/* results.
regressionSemantics.targetFailure: A failed target clause makes the stage ValidationFailed rather than Completed.

creatures.name: Obsidian Bulwark
creatures.lineupIdentity: Widest shoulders, squat torso, short forearms, broad feet.

initialBrief.text: Build the broadest, lowest Obsidian Warden without leaving the family vocabulary.

revisions.request: Widen shoulder span 20% and shoulder masses 15%; preserve height, face, and hands within 2%.
Shorten forearms 12% and replant palms; preserve upper arms.
Narrow the face plate 18% and project it 10% farther forward; preserve torso and shoulders.

creatures.name: Obsidian Climber
creatures.lineupIdentity: Longest forearms, largest hands, compact torso.

initialBrief.text: Build the reach-specialized Obsidian Warden with the family maximum forearms and hands.

revisions.request: Lengthen forearms 18%, holding shoulders and elbows while preserving hand contact.
Rigid-scale both hands 12% around their wrist junctions; preserve digit ratios.
Reduce torso radii 15%; preserve height and all limb endpoints.

creatures.name: Obsidian Sentinel
creatures.lineupIdentity: Tallest upright torso, small hands, narrow feet.

initialBrief.text: Build the tallest and most upright Obsidian Warden with restrained hands and feet.

revisions.request: Raise upper torso and face 12%; keep feet fixed and limb thickness unchanged.
Narrow shoulder span 10%, preserving wrists by re-aiming the arms.
Increase face height 15% and reduce depth 10%; preserve total height.

creatures.name: Obsidian Delver
creatures.lineupIdentity: Lowest forward lean, thickest forearms, splayed feet.

initialBrief.text: Build the lowest forward-driving Obsidian Warden with massive forearms and broad support.

revisions.request: Pitch torso and face forward 10 degrees; hands and feet remain within 0.02 units of ground.
Increase forearm radii 20%; preserve axes and hands.
Widen feet 18% and shorten them 12%; preserve centers and ground contact.

creatures.name: Obsidian Lancer
creatures.lineupIdentity: Narrowest torso, longest slim arms, smallest shoulders.

initialBrief.text: Build the narrow, long-reaching Obsidian Warden without leaving the shared body plan.

revisions.request: Lengthen upper arms 15%; hold shoulders fixed and preserve wrists by forearm re-aiming.
Reduce forearm radii 12%; keep endpoints and hands fixed.
Narrow the face 20% and increase projection 15%; preserve center and height.

creatures.name: Obsidian Porter
creatures.lineupIdentity: Barrel torso, broad hips, huge palms, short upper arms.

initialBrief.text: Build the load-bearing Obsidian Warden with the broadest trunk and hips and largest palms.

revisions.request: Increase lower torso radii 18%; preserve face and shoulders.
Rigid-scale hands 15% around the wrists; preserve contact.
Widen hips 15%; preserve foot centers and shoulder span.

creatures.name: Obsidian Strider
creatures.lineupIdentity: Longest rear legs, highest hips, slim upper body.

initialBrief.text: Build the long-legged Obsidian Warden with the highest rear chain and a narrow upper body.

revisions.request: Lengthen thighs 20% with feet planted; translate the body chain coherently and replant hands.
Lengthen feet 18%; preserve width and leg attachment.
Shorten forearms 10% and replant hands; keep shoulders and upper arms fixed.

creatures.name: Obsidian Oracle
creatures.lineupIdentity: Largest tall face plate, narrow shoulders, compact lower body.

initialBrief.text: Build the face-dominant Obsidian Warden with a compact support chain.

revisions.request: Increase face height 20% and narrow it 10%; preserve total height.
Rigid-scale hands down 12%; keep wrists and contact fixed.
Increase lower torso radius 18%; preserve face and shoulders.

blinding.randomizationAlgorithm: NumPy 2.5.1 Generator(PCG64).permutation over held-out manifest order crossed with arm manifest order
